thread:
maria_support: Acme reporting intermittent 504s from hosted API since 09:12 UTC. Customer seeing spikes in tail timeouts (~30s). Example curl reply:
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
{"error":"gateway_timeout","request_id":"r-abc123"}. Any quick mitigation? :rotating_light:
eli_oncall: Got it. Which tenant? rate? any reproducible request? paging @devin_eng @sre_bot
maria_support: tenant: acme-42 (Acme Inc). Spike started after a marketing blast ~09:05 UTC. Baseline qps ~12 -> burst ~320. Repro: single POST /v1/generate with prompt ~2k tokens. We saw queue depth hit limit and client-side retries.
sre_bot: Alert: ingress.queue.depth acme-42 = 1,280 (limit 1,000) at 2026-03-17T09:11:38Z
Continuous-batcher backlog = 48 batches pending
Dequeue time P99 = 28.4s
devin_eng: Sounds like continuous-batcher backlog + kvcache cold spin-up. I pulled batcher logs, snippet below:
```text
2026-03-17T09:11:35Z batcher: enqueued=512 queue_depth=1280 limit=1000 deferred_evictions=7
2026-03-17T09:11:36Z batcher: draining=0 kvcache_misses=83 cold_kv_init=4
2026-03-17T09:11:37Z gateway: dequeue_latency_ms=27600 p50=1200 p95=24000
```
eli_oncall: Temporary mitigations: 1) throttle tenant to 30% QPS 2) fallback to smaller model variant (lower mem / faster) 3) enable aggressive prefix-kvcache warm for active sessions. We can apply 1 & 2 quickly.
sarah_prod: If we fallback we need to notify customer about quality tradeoff. Also consider raising queue_depth_limit temporarily but that may delay other tenants.
devin_eng: Root cause likely many short-lived concurrent requests with high max_tokens so batcher accumulates and blocks dequeue. Repro steps I'm going to run: burst load against /v1/generate with 300 concurrent connections, max_tokens=2048, disable caching. I'll attach harness once ready.
maria_support: Customer ok with temporary throttle. Can someone run: `rctl throttle tenant acme-42 30%`? I will confirm on the customer call.
eli_oncall: Running now... `rctl` output: success. Throttled acme-42 -> 30% :thumbsup:
ingest_bot: Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/queues?tenant=acme-42 — queue depth trending down :hourglass_flowing_sand: (09:22 UTC)
sarah_prod: Please create a short postmortem and recommend autopilot: proactive tenant-rate caps + burst autoscale + batching guardrails. Assigning to @devin_eng and @eli_oncall.
devin_eng: Will capture logs, reproduce locally, and open PR with batching guardrails (early-drop / per-tenant queue shadowing). ETA 48h.
maria_support: Customer updated: 504s stopped after throttle, monitoring. Will update if any regressions. Closing if stable.
